# Dependencies — reinstalled from package-lock.json on every build
node_modules/

# Build output — regenerated by Astro on every deploy
dist/
.astro/

# Cloudflare local state
.wrangler/

# Secrets — never commit these
.env
.env.*
.dev.vars

# OS noise
.DS_Store
Thumbs.db

# NOTE: tina/__generated__ and tina/tina-lock.json are intentionally NOT
# ignored. TinaCloud reads both from the repo to index your content, and
# ignoring them is a common cause of the "Unable to find record
# tina/__generated__/_graphql.json" error.
